notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
The first patch has been released and includes changes to:
-        fixed the phrase in all endings about the fact that the treasure of the necromancer Ikaros has not yet been found. One of the adventurers found the treasure and notified the developers
-        fixed a few bugs in the text
-        replaced some CG background images
-        replaced some sprites - edited light and shadows

notes.title: Release. Reviews. Demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43363651/ab404c71b90bd3db9d3bd99c479b31f0eb7c5244.png[/img]
Dear our fans of magic, adventure and touching stories!

It's been 24 hours since the release of the game "The Day Before You Gone". We are very pleased to receive so much positive feedback! Thank you for your valuable feedback!

Every feedback is very important to us, so we ask that you leave them whenever possible.

We would also like to inform you that we are suspending the demo version of the game, because now it has become irrelevant and is an old build, in which not all mechanics work as they should.

Your Aequalis Studio

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43363651/ca670def1f293edaed3e9c63c863ae4e5d212aff.png[/img]
Thanks to Steam for writing us a letter advising us not to post the release on December 21. On that date the sale is launched, which makes it impossible to promote new products on the main page.

Everything that is not done is for the best. 

The Day Before You Gone will be released on Steam on January 5th. We really hope for your understanding, and we want to please you in time for the New Year holidays!

Feel the magic in you! Immerse yourself in our world! Make a step towards your destiny very soon!
